prompt:
A previous legacy import left the payment-provider code flattened into a few unclear catch-all files (for example app/legacy/z_provider.php, app/legacy/a.php, app/legacy/b.php, and app/misc/pay_ops.php), each mixing several provider concerns together. The checkout and webhook flows still work, but the provider-specific logic is painful to maintain.

Reorganize the provider code into clear payment modules at these canonical paths: app/Payment/GatewayInterface.php (the gateway contract), app/Payment/StripeMockGateway.php and app/Payment/PayFastMockGateway.php (the two provider gateways), app/Payment/WebhookVerifier.php (signature verification), and app/Payment/GatewayEventNormalizer.php (provider payload normalization). Payment orchestration must remain under app/Services/, public/index.php must remain the entrypoint, and the existing checkout, webhook, and admin report behavior must not change.
issue_title: Payment provider code is hard to maintain after a legacy import
issue_body:
A previous legacy import left the payment-provider code flattened into a few unclear catch-all files (for example app/legacy/z_provider.php, app/legacy/a.php, app/legacy/b.php, and app/misc/pay_ops.php), each mixing several provider concerns together. The checkout and webhook flows still work, but the provider-specific logic is painful to maintain.

Reorganize the provider code into clear payment modules at these canonical paths: app/Payment/GatewayInterface.php (the gateway contract), app/Payment/StripeMockGateway.php and app/Payment/PayFastMockGateway.php (the two provider gateways), app/Payment/WebhookVerifier.php (signature verification), and app/Payment/GatewayEventNormalizer.php (provider payload normalization). Payment orchestration must remain under app/Services/, public/index.php must remain the entrypoint, and the existing checkout, webhook, and admin report behavior must not change.
expected_behavior: Provider code lives under app/Payment/ at the canonical module paths, autoloaded by PSR-4.
Payment orchestration remains under app/Services/ and public/index.php remains the entrypoint.
Checkout, Stripe-like webhooks, PayFast-like webhooks, and the admin payment report all behave exactly as before.
The flattened legacy catch-all files are gone.
expected_failure_summary: Provider concerns (gateway contract, the two gateways, the webhook verifier, the event normalizer) are flattened into opaque legacy catch-all files loaded by an explicit bootstrap shim, so they cannot be imported or maintained at their canonical App\Payment module paths.
task_author_notes: Reorg. Broken flattens the five App\Payment classes into app/legacy/{z_provider,a,b}.php + app/misc/pay_ops.php, with a bootstrap.php shim that require()s them since they are off the PSR-4 path. Restoring the five canonical app/Payment/*.php modules (gold already has them) and removing the legacy files + shim satisfies the structure contract and the hidden behaviour checks, which gate each behaviour on the corresponding canonical file existing. Long-output candidate: run_output_stress.py emits ~190 KB.
